# Show us your scenes, screenshots and classic version runs
With the Builder (B) you can publish your own Decentraland-style scene on your parcels, and with the new launcher you can go back and play every version from v1 to v10.

Share screenshots of your scenes, your favorite spots in Genesis City, your best Squid Game Epic Edition run or something fun you found in an old build. Shift+U hides the interface for clean screenshots.
